joinPolicy.admissionRule: Require one workbook row for the exact plotted UTEX 2973 current locus, a non-empty PCC 7942 current locus, and exactly one unambiguous pinned crosswalk relationship whose PCC locus equals the workbook PCC locus. An admitted PCC locus may map to only one plotted UTEX locus.
joinPolicy.interpretation: beneficial is a distinct source status and is never promoted to essential
joinPolicy.missingness: Unmatched, conflicting, ambiguous, or multi-valued joins are status unknown with an explicit reason. An admitted row with a blank source call is status missing. Neither case is non-essential.

source.crossStrainAssumption: A PCC 7942 call is associated with a UTEX 2973 plotted CDS only when the workbook's exact current-locus pair agrees with one unambiguous pcc7942_ortholog relationship in the pinned crosswalk. Shared-protein orthology does not establish identical essentiality across strains: every admitted value remains PCC 7942 evidence under the source study conditions, not a measured UTEX 2973 phenotype.

essentialityCalls.assayContext: PCC 7942 RB-TnSeq study conditions: 30 C in BG-11 under multiple light regimes; consult Rubin et al. 2015 for the individual regime definitions.
essentialityCalls.representation: These are the PCC 7942 calls redistributed by Adomako et al. Data Set S1 and attributed there to Rubin et al.; this dataset does not claim to reproduce Rubin et al. original Dataset S3.
